name: SCDO Agent Ledger
description: ERC-8004-format agent identity registry on SCDO Shard0 with x402 (HTTP 402) USDC pay-per-call on Base.
status: ERC-8004-compatible implementation of a draft standard; not an official certification.

register.auth: EIP-191 signature by the agent key over "SCDO Agent Ledger v1\n" + canonical JSON of the payload
register.cost: free: no fee, no gas, no KYC, no approval
register.limits: 10 new agents per IP per day, 120 signed requests per minute

note: This file is a static pointer. The agent list is live; read it from the endpoints above rather than from this repository.

erc8444.status: ERC-8444 ARD-aligned descriptors (draft standard; compatible implementation, level 0, no on-chain ARD registry deployed)
